**Dish:** Gulab Jamun
**Cuisine:** Indian
**Ingredients (likely):** Khoya (reduced milk solids), all-purpose flour, sugar, cardamom, rose water, ghee, pistachios
**Estimated calories:** 350-400 kcal (per serving of 2 pieces)
**Macros (approx per serving):** Protein: 5g | Carbs: 55g | Fat: 15g
**Health notes:** High in sugar and saturated fat; contains dairy and gluten. Enjoy in moderation as an occasional treat.

Gulab jamun is definitely not a healthy meal, as it is very high in sugar, refined flour, and saturated fat. It's best to enjoy these delicious fried dough balls as an occasional sweet treat rather than part of your daily diet.
